text:
nina: FYI nightly eval spike: answer-duplication failure rate jumped x7 for redwood-v2-3b-quant on promptset customer-support-sim. repro logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1859991234
rahul: Is this only on quant builds or also fp32?
maria: I saw something in canary yesterday, looked like repeated paragraph halves. I rolled back a small token mapping tweak before leaving.
sam (evals-bot): auto-summary: metric=answer_duplication_rate new=0.23 baseline=0.031 delta=+0.199 tests_failed=42/120 promptset=customer-support-sim
kevin: putting on eng-runtime radar. we merged a KV-cache keying optimization yesterday (PR #4672) that changed cache key from (model,session) -> (model) for a cross-request speedup. suspecting cross-session reuse.
nina: ok can you confirm timeline vs nightly run? last runtime change deploy was 1859988000 (staging)->1859990000 (prod). eval started at 1859990500.
kevin: timeline lines up. I can reproduce locally by sending two different sessions rapidly; second call picks up prefix tokens from first and duplicates answers.
rahul: interesting — why is duplication manifesting as repeated answer fragments rather than full prefix? any tokenizer interactions?
kevin: quantized variant has slightly different eos/unk handling after our tokenmap tweak; that + cache mixing yields partial-sequence repetition. without kv flush, the KV cache continues from earlier call and attention attends to old tokens.
maria: so it's two factors: cache key regression + quantized token mapping sensitivity. makes sense why fp32 appeared fine in earlier logs.
nina: proposed immediate mitigations: 1) revert cache key change in prod canary, 2) gate any new quant builds from shipping if nightly eval duplication > 0.05, 3) temporary revert the quant tokenmap tweak from yesterday, 4) add unit/integration test that calls two sessions and ensures no cross-session token reuse. owners?
rahul: I can own gating rule in nightly eval harness. will add threshold check and fail-build hook.
maria: I'll coordinate rollback of tokenmap tweak and block the quant artifact in registry.
kevin: I'll open rollback + hotfix PR to restore session-level keying and add a regression test that reproduces the issue. PR: https://git.internal/r/kevin/4679
nina: timeline: rollback to canary in next 30m, monitor 2 cycles (6h), if clean, promote to prod. gating rule by EOD. add CI test tomorrow.
kevin: canary deploy succeeded: deploy-bot: canary-deploy redwood-runtime@v1.9.3-rollback (1859992500) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: prod promotion pending 6h clean window.
maria: blocked new quant artifacts in registry and notified release manager.
rahul: gating rule implemented in nightly harness and turned on for failing promptset. sam (evals-bot): next night run will auto-fail PRs that increase duplication above 0.05.
nina: thanks all. follow-ups: (A) kevin: merge hotfix and backfill test (ETA 24h), (B) rahul: ship gating rule to CI and docs (ETA EOD), (C) maria: confirm quant artifact block + rollback (ETA 1h), (D) nina: write short RCA and postmortem once metrics stable (ETA 48h).
kevin: noted, will add a small telemetry field to KV events to catch future regressions.
maria: will also add a quick eval card in console to show duplication per model/version.
nina: great. creating a follow-up thread for the postmortem writeup.
